title: What happens if you never eat vitamin C again?

lines.text: What happens if you never eat vitamin C again?
Most animals make their own vitamin C. You lost that gene sixty million years ago.
By week six, there's no vitamin C left in your blood.
A surgeon really tried this in 1939. At month three, a cut on his back healed fine.
At month six, a new cut didn't heal at all.
Vitamin C went back in, and he recovered.
You survived. Comment what you want to know next.

experiment.note: Trial of the Fish-led format (george 2026-11-25: the NSTAAF master fact list is the sole idea source). Lead: episode #421 (No Such Thing As The Knipper & The Corpse); re-sourced independently. Rendered in the cel prototype style.

facts.claim: Humans (and other anthropoid primates) can't make vitamin C: the GULO gene broke ~61 million years ago
Crandon (Boston City Hospital) began a no-vitamin-C diet in Oct 1939; plasma vitamin C hit zero after ~41 days
A back incision at 3 months healed normally; one at 6 months showed no healing
He collapsed and lost consciousness during a sprint
